description: Open the dataset 'ToothGrowth_Sentinels.csv' located in '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/'. This dataset uses the value -99 to represent missing data in the 'len' column. Your task is to configure the variable properties for 'len' to treat -99 as a missing value (do NOT delete the rows). After configuring the missing value code, run a Descriptives analysis on the 'len' variable to find the corrected Mean. Save the project as 'ToothGrowth_Cleaned.omv' in the same directory. Finally, create a text file named 'corrected_mean.txt' in '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/' containing just the numeric value of the corrected mean.
